name: Conflicting settings
description: True/False questions worth 10 marks at Bloom's 'Create'.
expected: Warned at validation; generated anyway with marks scaled down and/or a Bloom mismatch flagged by the checker.
actual: Warned at validation; 3 produced with marks [2], avg 3.0/10, 3 flagged

warnings: 10 marks for a True/False question is unusual; the generator will scale the marks down to a defensible value.
Bloom's level 'Create' is hard to assess with True/False only; the quality checker will likely flag a Bloom mismatch.

pipeline.first_question: True or False: If an operating system designer sets the time quantum in a Round Robin scheduling algorithm to an extremely large value, the system's scheduling behavior effectively transforms into a First-Come First-Served (FCFS) non-preemptive model.

name: Malformed model JSON (parser unit test)
description: Three bad payloads fed straight to the parser/validator: prose wrapper, truncated JSON, MCQ answer absent from options.
expected: Each rejected with a specific error, which is what triggers the one retry in the live path.
actual: Prose+fence recovered; truncated JSON raised ValueError; bad MCQ answer rejected
passed: Question 1 is an MCQ whose answer is not one of its options.

detail.truncated: ValueError: No JSON object found in the model response.
answer_not_in_options: Question 1 is an MCQ whose answer is not one of its options.
